findings.action: Separate operational resources from the scholarly corpus; never coerce an operational or guessed year into publication_year; recompute all corpus counts.
Classify Jannach and Chen as editorial/essay and use peer_reviewed=false or unknown unless direct venue evidence proves external review.
Normalize canonical titles and complete author lists from authoritative metadata and reject mojibake or et al. in canonical fields.
Bound prevalence statements to the reviewed candidate set and retain the targeted, non-exhaustive search qualifier.
Record source-family dependencies and report canonical-record count separately from independent-family count.
Acquire and verify the 24-source core set named by the independent audit, add durable claim locators, and apply the same rule to every source used in production prose.
Persist a write-once synthesis invocation ledger with input manifest hash/time, synthesis start time, and final output hash.
Snapshot Complete Journey provider URL, access time, exact terms bytes, edition/revision and checksums; keep execution, sharing, and redistribution unauthorized until reviewed.
